pages.text: Warm milk is the slow, steady alternative: it directly reduces a small amount of debt and improves your next rest. It does not cause a caffeine crash.

Use the coffee machine: put the base liquid or drink in the first slot, the ingredient in the second and coal or charcoal in the third. Water + grounds makes coffee. Coffee + redstone lasts longer; coffee + glowstone is stronger; strong coffee + sugar makes energy drink. Upgrade energy with redstone or glowstone. Tea uses dried herbs. JEI/EMI list all machine recipes.
